Download the application form from the official website: https://ranipet.nic.in.

Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Child Protection Unit, Ranipet (DCPU Ranipet) for filling up temporary positions in the district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DCPU Ranipet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the posts of Junior Assistant Cum Bench Clerk and Office Assistant under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the names of the posts offered?
faq.answer: The posts included in this recruitment are Junior Assistant Cum Bench Clerk and Office Assistant on a fully temporary consolidated pay contract basis for one year.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Ranipet recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 26 February 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form from the official website, fill it out, and send it by post or hand.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Junior Assistant Cum Bench Clerk?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the SSLC (Class 10) public examination or its equivalent and have proficiency in computers, with preference given for typing certificates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification for Office Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Office Assistant post must have passed the VIII (Class 8) standard from any recognized State or Private School Board.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 42 years. Candidates should verify age limits from the official notification before applying.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 13,000/- to Rs. 20,000/- per month depending upon the specific post on a consolidated pay contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The filled application form along with self-attested copies of certificates should be sent to the District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, 4th Floor, F-Block, Ranipet District.
